description: Na₄Ni₇O₁₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with six NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.20 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.69 Å. There are seven inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.91 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.90 Å. In the third Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-1.92 Å. In the fourth Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.89 Å. In the fifth Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.94 Å. In the sixth Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.90 Å. In the seventh Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra and edges with five NiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-1.92 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Ni atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid, edges with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Ni atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, corners with three ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramid, and edges with two ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ni atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids that share corners with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, corners with two ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid, corners with four ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid, corners with four ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramid, corners with three ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ni atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Ni atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Ni atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Ni atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ni₂ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramid, and edges with three ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Ni atoms to form distorted ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, and edges with two ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ni atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ni₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, corners with four ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three ONa₂Ni₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNi₃ trigonal pyramid.
